all twelve distinct tubes and caps versus rotor, frame, lid, rack, neighbors and robot

fixed source-selected NanoDrop and Qubit native bodies

moving_station_clearance.moving_groups: All actual nonconstant station coordinates and descendants; rotor-owned samples move with Rotor; only active rotor-owned sample follows TubeLift.
moving_station_clearance.window_source: Recomputed from actual station PVA polynomials, including index, lift, brakes, latches and final lid movement.

native.scope: Adaptive discrete native BRep intersections and conservative distance lower bounds, with exact BRep refinement below required margins. Actual C2 quintics, all knots and event sides; no continuous swept-volume, hardware, biology or safety qualification. Qubit stays in its source-selected frozen cover pose; NanoDrop full hinge envelopes conservatively overestimate actual occupied volume.

nanosecond_quantization.knot_values: Interior P/V/A evaluated at rounded reference times; exact rest endpoint jets retained
nanosecond_quantization.method: Numerical polynomial extrema of normalized quintic differences plus knot-shift/global derivative bounds; actual wire extrema checked independently

robot_description_requirements.compatibility_check: Required before execution; not performed by the trajectory client

interpolation.requirement: The running joint_trajectory_controller must use spline interpolation for P/V/A knots; not inspected by this client

historical_solidcraft_limit: The original full STEP import left rotor and five servo housings open and failed strict overall validation. Historical media provenance remains unchanged; later independent SolidCraft static poses are not a new native motion study.
limitations: Synthetic provisional limits; biological_tolerance is null. No fluid, pellet, grip force, drive/load, resonance or shared-bench vibration qualification.
No global time-optimality claim; adaptive conservative numerical intervals are not a formal floating-point certificate.
Native adaptive discrete BRep checking is not a continuous swept-volume certificate, live collision control or safety qualification.
Opt-in open-lid indexing has no standard Simulator, MockProtocol, ROS, SiLA, batch-runner or combined-workflow binding. Existing index/start contracts remain unchanged.
Replay uses synthetic program-state observations, future latch confirmations and injected logical heartbeats; no measured sensor, command duration or watchdog evidence.
The arm program has no station/sensor-dependent abort or recovery branch. Gripper/station control is not included in the ROS arm export.
ROS data export and dry-run only; live spline configuration, robot-model compatibility, ROS runtime and hardware execution remain unverified.
No transporter, native loading path, physical spin, hardware quality feedback or new native SolidCraft motion study.
Motion time, old batch-test time and accelerated video time are distinct. Only the default three-sample prefix was executed and checked.
Whole-repository checks retain the recorded unrelated cached evidence and gallery gaps; skipped tests are not counted as passed.
